Executive AI FinOps & ROI 8-Card Micro-Chart Playbook
How Engineering & Finance Teams Deliver Verifiable AI Returns Without Blowing Token or License Budgets
Stack Anchor: Google Cloud Vertex AI + Spanner Graph + Model Armor + OpenTelemetry | KPIs: Payback <= 4.2 Months · -68% Cost / Outcome
GOVERNANCE & PERSONA CONTRACT: Board Sign-Off Gate: Fund next phase strictly from verified pilot savings.
📊 License/API is 15% tip; 85% is Data Prep + Integration +
✓ Budget for Day-2 evals & maintenance, never just Day-1 launch
📊 Monthly Value = Hours Saved × Loaded Rate × Verified Active
✓ Payback (Months) = Setup Cost ÷ Monthly Net Validated Gain
✓ Climb one rung only when the rung below fails measured SLOs
📊 Overkill (Frontier for bool gates) vs Right-Sized (Flash ->
✓ Route 80% of deterministic/triage turns to <15ms small models
📊 Pick 1 high-volume use case -> Run 30-day pilot -> Measure
✓ Fund every subsequent wave strictly from the prior pilot's
📊 Track Cost Curve vs Realized Value Curve until Break-Even
📊 15 Active Power Seats (Green) vs 9 Dormant Seats (Gray) =
✓ Reclaim & reassign inactive seats every 30 days before buying
📊 Tool Only (1.2x Value/Cost) vs Tool + 45m Role-Based
✓ Appoint 1 practitioner AI Champion per squad to compound
